faqs.question: Why take FISH for Aneuploidy in POC - Chromosomes 13,18,21, X,Y Test?
Is this test for you?
faqs.answer: This test is done on POC (abortous tissue) samples to evaluate cause (genetic) of miscarriage.

faqs.question: More Info on FISH for Aneuploidy in POC - Chromosomes 13,18,21, X,Y Test
faqs.answer: This test evaluate reason for miscarriage. FISH for Chr 13,18, 21, X and Y. Detailed clinical history of the patient is required.
